summary.en: A balanced equation gives the fixed ratio in which substances react, in moles rather than in grams — so predicting how much product forms means converting to moles, applying the ratio, and converting back.
summary.et: Tasakaalustatud võrrand annab kindla suhte, milles ained reageerivad, moolides, mitte grammides — seega tähendab saaduse koguse ennustamine moolideks teisendamist, suhte rakendamist ja tagasi teisendamist.
